description: This file contains functions and preferences for configuring Firefox profiles, including default preferences and profile creation logic, used in automated testing or browser setup within the Playwright project.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a Firefox profile directory and writes preferences to it, merging default and custom preferences.

methods.name: defaultProfilePreferences
methods.description: Generates a set of default preferences for a Firefox profile, with optional extra preferences.

methods.name: writePreferences
methods.description: Writes the preferences to the profile's prefs.js and creates a backup of existing preferences.
